paite: Huan, Abraham a hong upataa, a hong tek mahmah taa: huan, Toupan Abraham thil bangkimah a vualjawl hi.
english: Abraham was old, and well stricken in age. Yahweh had blessed Abraham in all things.

paite: Huan, Abrahamin, a sikha, a inkuanpihte laka upapen, a neih tengteng tunga thuneipa kiangah, Hehpihtakin na khut ka pheipi nuiah golhin:
english: Abraham said to his servant, the elder of his house, who ruled over all that he had, “Please put your hand under my thigh.

paite: Huchiin, Toupa, van Pathian leh lei Pathian louin, ka omna Kanan mite nungak laka mi ka tapa ji dinga neihsak lou dingin, ka hon kichiamsak ding ahi:
english: I will make you swear by Yahweh, the God of heaven and the God of the earth, that you shall not take a wife for my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I live.

paite: Ka gam lama, ka tanaute kianga hoha, ka tapa Isaak ji na neihsak zo ding ahi, achia.
english: But you shall go to my country, and to my relatives, and take a wife for my son Isaac.”

paite: Huan, sikhain, a kiangah, Numeiin hiai gam lamah honjui nuam khol kei dia: na tapa na hong pawtna gam lamah ka pi kik nawn ding ahi diam? A chia.
english: The servant said to him, “What if the woman isn’t willing to follow me to this land? Must I bring your son again to the land you came from?”

paite: Huan, Abrahamin, a kiangah, ka tapa huailaia pi kik nawnlou dingin pilvangin.
english: Abraham said to him, “Beware that you don’t bring my son there again.

paite: Toupa van Pathian, ka pa in akipan leh ka pianna gam a kipan hon pikhepa leh hon houpihpa leh, hiai gam na suante kiangah ka pe ding, chia, ka kianga kichiampan, amah ngeiin a angel na maah a paisak dinga, huai akipanin ka tapa ji na hon neisak ding hi.
english: Yahweh, the God of heaven, who took me from my father’s house, and from the land of my birth, who spoke to me, and who swore to me, saying, ‘I will give this land to your seed or, offspring .’ He will send his angel before you, and you shall take a wife for my son from there.

paite: Huan, numeiin a hon zuih nop kei leh, ka kianga na kichiamna thu ah na siang mai ding; a bang a bang hitaleh, ka tapa huailaiah na pi kik nawn ding ahi kei, achia.
english: If the woman isn’t willing to follow you, then you shall be clear from this my oath. Only you shall not bring my son there again.”

paite: Huchiin, sikhain a khut a pu Abraham pheipi nuaiah a golha, huai thu ah a kiangah a kichiamta hi.
english: The servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and swore to him concerning this matter.

paite: Huan, sikhain a pu sangawngsau laka sangawngsau sawm a kaia, a pu thil hoih chiteng tawiin, a pawttaa: huchiin a thoua, Mesopotamia gam a, Nahorte khua aha hoha.
english: The servant took ten camels, of his master’s camels, and departed, having a variety of good things of his master’s with him. He arose, and went to Mesopotamia, to the city of Nahor.

paite: Huan, nitaklama, numeite tuitawi dinga a kuan hun lai tak un, dainawla tuileh kiangah a sangawngsaute akhukdinsak a.
english: He made the camels kneel down outside the city by the well of water at the time of evening, the time that women go out to draw water.

paite: Huan, Aw Toupa, ka pu Abraham Pathian, hehpihtakin tuniin hon lohchingsak in, ka pu Abraham tungah hehpihna langsakin.
english: He said, “Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, please give me success this day, and show kindness to my master Abraham.

paite: Enin, tuikhuk kiangah ka dinga, khua a mite tanute leng tuitawi dingin a hongkuan uh:
english: Behold, I am standing by the spring of water. The daughters of the men of the city are coming out to draw water.

paite: Huchiin, hichi hihen, nungak kuapeuh kianga, hehpihtakin ka dawn dingin na tui bel niamsak dih ve, ka chiha, huan, aman, Dawnin, na sangawngsaute leng dawn ding ka pe ding, chi peuhmah, huai mi ngei na sikha Isaak a dinga na mi seh hihen; huan huaiah ka pu tungah hehpihna na langsak chih ka thei ding hi, a chi hi.
english: Let it happen, that the young lady to whom I will say, ‘Please let down your pitcher, that I may drink,’ and she will say, ‘Drink, and I will also give your camels a drink,’—let her be the one you have appointed for your servant Isaac. By this I will know that you have shown kindness to my master.”

paite: Huan, hichi ahia, a gen khit main, ngaiin, Abraham nau Nahor ji Milka tapa Bethuel tanu Rebeka tui bel a liangjang a puain a hongkuana.
english: It happened, before he had finished speaking, that behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel the son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham’s brother, with her pitcher on her shoulder.

paite: Huai nungak a mel a hoih mahmaha, nungak siangthou ahi a, pasal himhimin a kithuahpih ngei hetkei uh. Huan, tuikhuk ah a pai suka, a tuibel a dimsaka, a pai tou nawna.
english: The young lady was very beautiful to look at, a virgin, neither had any man known her. She went down to the spring, filled her pitcher, and came up.

paite: Huan, sikha amah tuak dingin a taia, Hehpihtakin na tuibel a tui tawm chik hondan sak ve, achia.
english: The servant ran to meet her, and said, “Please give me a drink, a little water from your pitcher.”

paite: Huan, aman, dawn ve, ka toupa, achia; huan, kintakin a tuibel a khut in a dom khe suka, a dawnsak hi.
english: She said, “Drink, my lord.” She hurried, and let down her pitcher on her hand, and gave him drink.

paite: Huan, a dawn nungin, na sangawngsaute dingin leng a dawn kham masiah uh ka tawi jel ding, achia.
english: When she had done giving him drink, she said, “I will also draw for your camels, until they have done drinking.”

paite: Huan, kintakin a tuibel a gan kuangah a teia, tui tawi dingin tuileh lamah a tai nawna, a sangawngsau tengteng a dingin leng a tawitawi hi.
english: She hurried, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again to the well to draw, and drew for all his camels.

paite: Huan, sikhain a lohchingsak leh saklouh theihna dingin a dai didea.
english: The man looked steadfastly at her, remaining silent, to know whether Yahweh had made his journey prosperous or not.

paite: Huan, hichi ahia, sangawngsauten a dawn kham takun sikhain dangkaeng bilbah makhai buk leh, a khut a dinga tau nih dangkaeng dangka sawm buk a suaha;
english: It happened, as the camels had done drinking, that the man took a golden ring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold,

paite: Huan, a kiangah, kua tanu na hia? Hehpihtakin hin hilh in. Na pa in ah ka giahna ding uh mun om ding hia? achia.
english: and said, “Whose daughter are you? Please tell me. Is there room in your father’s house for us to lodge in?”

paite: Huan, aman, a kiangah, Bethuel, Milka tapa, Nahor adinga neihsaknu tanu ka hi, achia.
english: She said to him, “I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, whom she bore to Nahor.”

paite: Huan, amah mahin, a kiangah, buhpawl leh gan an ka hau tuaktuak ua, giahna mun leng ka nei uh, achia.
english: She said moreover to him, “We have both straw and provender enough, and room to lodge in.”

paite: Huchiin, sikhain a lu a kunsaka, Toupa chibai a buk hi.
english: The man bowed his head, and worshiped Yahweh.

paite: Huan, ka pu tunga a hehpihna leh a takna tawp tuanlou, toupa, ka pu Abraham Pathian, phatin om hen: kei leng, Toupan ka pu unaute in lamah hon na pi eive, achia.
english: He said, “Blessed be Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, who has not forsaken his loving kindness and his truth toward my master. As for me, Yahweh has led me in the way to the house of my master’s relatives.”

paite: Huan, nungak a taia, huai thute a nu inkuanpihte a vahilh hi.
english: The young lady ran, and told her mother’s house about these words.

paite: Rebekain sanggam pasal a neia, a min Laban ahia: huchiin, Laban a pawta, tuikhuk lamah, mi kiangah a vatai taa.
english: Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban. Laban ran out to the man, to the spring.

paite: Hichi ahia, bilbah leh a sanggamnu khut a taute a mua, min huchi khachiin honchi, chia, a sanggamnu Rebeka thu gente a jak takin, huai mi kiangah a hohta a; huan, ngaiin, amah tuikhuka sangawngsaute kiangah a na ding gige a.
english: It happened, when he saw the ring, and the bracelets on his sister’s hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, “This is what the man said to me,” that he came to the man. Behold, he was standing by the camels at the spring.

paite: Huan, Labanin, nang Toupa vualjawl pa, hong inla, ka in ah lutin; bangdia inpua a ding nilouh? in leh sangawngsaute adingin mun ka bawl khinta, achia.
english: He said, “Come in, you blessed of Yahweh. Why do you stand outside? For I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.”

paite: Huan, huai in ah a luta, huan Labanin sangawngsau van a phela; huan, sangawngsaute adingin buhpawl leh gan an apia a, akhe leh a lawmte khe silna dingin tui a pia hi.
english: The man came into the house, and he unloaded the camels. He gave straw and provender for the camels, and water to wash his feet and the feet of the men who were with him.

paite: Huan, Abraham sikha maah nek ding a lui ua; himahleh, aman, ka hong na san thu kagen mateng ka ne kei ding, achia. Huan, aman, gen ve, achia.
english: Food was set before him to eat, but he said, “I will not eat until I have told my message.” He said, “Speak on.”

paite: Huan, aman, Abraham sikha ka hi.
english: He said, “I am Abraham’s servant.

paite: Huan, Toupan ka pu nakpiin a vualjawla, mi liantak a honghi a: Toupan a kiangah belam honte, bawng honte, dangkate, dangkaengte, sikhapate, sikhanute, sangawngsaute, sabengtung te leng a pia.
english: Yahweh has blessed my master greatly. He has become great. He has given him flocks and herds, silver and gold, male servants and female servants, and camels and donkeys.

paite: Ku pu ji Sarain tek ningin ka pu adingin tapa a neia: amah kiangah a neih tengteng a pe vek hi.
english: Sarah, my master’s wife, bore a son to my master when she was old. He has given all that he has to him.

paite: Huan, ka puin, ka omna gama Kanante nungak laka ka tapa ji dinga na neihsak ding ahi kei:
english: My master made me swear, saying, ‘You shall not take a wife for my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I live,

paite: Ka pa in lamah, ka tanaute kiangah hohin, ka tapa dingin ji na neihsak zo ding ahi, chiin, hon kichiamsaka.
english: but you shall go to my father’s house, and to my relatives, and take a wife for my son.’

paite: Huan, ken ka pu kiangah, Numeiin honjui nuam kei kha ding, ka chia.
english: I asked my master, ‘What if the woman will not follow me?’

paite: Huan, aman, ka kiangah, Toupa a maa ka om jelnain a angel na kiangah honsawl dinga; na hohna dingah hon lohchingsak ding; huchiin, ka tapa dingin ka tanaute leh ka pa inkuanpihte laka ji dingin na neihsak ding hi:
english: He said to me, ‘Yahweh, before whom I walk, will send his angel with you, and prosper your way. You shall take a wife for my son of my relatives, and of my father’s house.

paite: Ka tanaute kiang ngeia na tun chiangin ka kianga na kichiamna apat na siang ding; nungak a honpiak kei uleh ka kianga na kichiamna akipan na siang ding, achia.
english: Then will you be clear from my oath, when you come to my relatives. If they don’t give her to you, you shall be clear from my oath.’

paite: Huchiin, tuniin tuikhuk ka hongtunga, Aw, Toupa, ka pu Abraham Pathian, ka paina ah na hon lohchinsak ding leh, enin, tuikhuk kiangah ka ding hi:
english: I came this day to the spring, and said, ‘Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, if now you do prosper my way which I go—

paite: Huan, hichi hi hen, nungak tui tawi dinga hongkuan, kuapeuh kianga, hehpihtakin dawn dingin na tuibel a tui tawm chik honpe ve, ka chih a;
english: behold, I am standing by this spring of water. Let it happen, that the maiden who comes out to draw, to whom I will say, “Please give me a little water from your pitcher to drink,”

paite: Huan, aman, ka kianga, dawnin, sa sangawngsaute ading leng ka tawi ding, chi peuhmah, huai mi ngeingei ka pu tapa adinga Toupa numei seh hihen, ka chia.
english: and she will tell me, “Drink, and I will also draw for your camels,”—let her be the woman whom Yahweh has appointed for my master’s son.’

paite: Huan, ka lungsim a ka gen khit main, ngaiin, Rebeka a tuibel puain a hongkuana; huan, tuikhuk ah a paisuka, tui a tawia; huan, a kiangah, hehpihtakin tui hondawnsak ve, ka chia.
english: Before I had finished speaking in my heart, behold, Rebekah came out with her pitcher on her shoulder. She went down to the spring, and drew. I said to her, ‘Please let me drink.’

paite: Huan, aman kintakin a liangjang akipan tuibel a dom khiaa, dawnin, na sangawngsaute leng dawn ding ka pe ding, achia: huchiin ka dawna, sangawngsaute leng a dawnsaka.
english: She hurried and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and said, ‘Drink, and I will also give your camels a drink.’ So I drank, and she also gave the camels a drink.

paite: Huan, ken, kua tanu na hia? chiin, ka donga. Huan, aman, Bethuel, Nohar tapa, Milkhain a neihsakpa tanu, achia: huan bilbah abil ah ka batsaka, taute leng a khut ah ka bunsak.
english: I asked her, and said, ‘Whose daughter are you?’ She said, ‘The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor’s son, whom Milcah bore to him.’ I put the ring on her nose, and the bracelets on her hands.

paite: Huan, ka lu ka kunsaka, Toupa chibai ka buka, Toupa, ka pu Abraham Pathian, ka pu unaupa tanu a tapa adinga ji dia neisak dinga lampi diktaka honpipa, ka phat hi.
english: I bowed my head, and worshiped Yahweh, and blessed Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, who had led me in the right way to take my master’s brother’s daughter for his son.

paite: Huchiin, tuin ka pu na hehpih ua, a tunga chihtak peta na hih ding uleh honhilh un; na hih kei ding uleh leng honhilh un; huchiin taklam hiam, veilam hiam, ka nga thei ding hi, achia.
english: Now if you will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me. If not, tell me, that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.”

paite: Huan, Laban leh Bethuel in a dawng ua, hiai thil Toupa kianga kipana pawt ahi: a sia a pha leng na kiangah ka gen theikei uh.
english: Then Laban and Bethuel answered, “The thing proceeds from Yahweh. We can’t speak to you bad or good.

paite: Enin, Rebeka na maah a om hi, pi inla, pain, Toupan a gensa bangin na pu tapa ji dingin om hen, a chi ua.
english: Behold, Rebekah is before you. Take her, and go, and let her be your master’s son’s wife, as Yahweh has spoken.”

paite: Huan, hichi ahia, Abraham sikhain a thu uh a jak takin lei siin Toupa chibai a buk hi.
english: It happened that when Abraham’s servant heard their words, he bowed himself down to the earth to Yahweh.

paite: Huan, Abraham sikhain dangka suang kizepnate leh, dangkaeng kizepnate leh, silh leh ten a lakhia a, Rebeka kiangah a pia a: a sanggampa kiangah leh a nu kiangah leng thil manpha pipi a pia hi.
english: The servant brought out jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and clothing, and gave them to Rebekah. He also gave precious things to her brother and her mother.

paite: Huan, amah leh a lawmten a ne ua a dawn ua, a giakta ua; huan, jingsangin a thou ua ka pu kiangah honpaisakta un, achia.
english: They ate and drank, he and the men who were with him, and stayed all night. They rose up in the morning, and he said, “Send me away to my master.”

paite: Huan, a sanggampa leh a nuin, naunu ni sawtlou chik ni sawm lel bek, ka kiang uah om tadih hen; huai khit chiangin a kuan nading, a chi ua.
english: Her brother and her mother said, “Let the young lady stay with us a few days, at least ten. After that she will go.”

paite: Huan, aman, a kiang uah, hon zekai sak kei dih ua, Toupan leh ka hohna ah hon lohching sakta ngala; ka pu kianga ka pai theihna dingin, honsawl zomai ve ua, achia.
english: He said to them, “Don’t hinder me, since Yahweh has prospered my way. Send me away that I may go to my master.”

paite: Huan, amau, naunu ka sam ding ua, amah kam mahmah kihoupih leh, a chi ua.
english: They said, “We will call the young lady, and ask her.”

paite: Huchiin, Rebeka a sam ua a kiangah, hiai mipa kiangah na pai nuam maw a chi ua, huan, aman, pai nuam ve ning e, achia.
english: They called Rebekah, and said to her, “Will you go with this man?” She said, “I will go.”

paite: Huchiin, a sanggamnu uh Rebeka leh, a donnu leh, Abraham sikha leh a lawite a paita uhi.
english: They sent away Rebekah, their sister, with her nurse, Abraham’s servant, and his men.

paite: Huan, Rebeka a vualjawl ua, a kiangah, ka sanggamnu uh aw, nang sing ngenta sang tampi nu honghi inla, na suanten amau hote kulh kongkhak neihsak uhen, a chi ua.
english: They blessed Rebekah, and said to her, “Our sister, may you be the mother of thousands of ten thousands, and let your seed possess the gate of those who hate them.”

paite: Huchiin, Rebeka a thoua, a sikhanute toh, sangawngsaute tungah a tuang ua, mi a juita uh; huchiin Abraham sikhain Rebeka a pi a, apaita.
english: Rebekah arose with her ladies. They rode on the camels, and followed the man. The servant took Rebekah, and went his way.

paite: Huan, Isaak Beer-lahai-roi lam akipan a honga, Sim gama om ahi ngala,
english: Isaac came from the way of Beer Lahai Roi, for he lived in the land of the South.

paite: Huan, Isaak nitaklam pawnah kingaihtuah dingin a pawtkhia a: huan a daka, a ena, huan ngaiin, sangawngsau hongpaite a mu hi.
english: Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the evening. He lifted up his eyes, and saw, and, behold, there were camels coming.

paite: Huan, Rebeka a daka, Isaak a muhtakin sangawngsau tunga kipan a kuma.
english: Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she dismounted from the camel.

paite: Huan, Abraham sikha kiangah, pawna hondawn dinga hongpai kua ahia? Achia. Huan, sikhain, ka pu eive, achia: huchiin a kikhuhna puan a laa, a kikhuhta hi.
english: She said to the servant, “Who is the man who is walking in the field to meet us?” The servant said, “It is my master.” She took her veil, and covered herself.

paite: Huan, sikhain a thilhih tengteng Isaak a hilha.Huan, Isaakin Rebeka a nu Sara puan in ah a pi luta, huan, Rebeka a la a, a ji a honghita a; huan amah a it mahmah a: huchiin Isaak a nu sih nungin leng a hong lungmuang theita hi.
english: The servant told Isaac all the things that he had done.

paite: Huan, Isaakin Rebeka a nu Sara puan in ah a pi luta, huan, Rebeka a la a, a ji a honghita a; huan amah a it mahmah a: huchiin Isaak a nu sih nungin leng a hong lungmuang theita hi.
english: Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah’s tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife. He loved her. Isaac was comforted after his mother’s death.
